macrostructure: Task-first identity forms and applicant/staff workspaces
brief: Redesign auth and CFP landing pages and apps while preserving the main homepage, typography, colors, and brand
enrichment: None. Reused the original logo and self-hosted fonts.
changes: Compact auth forms with separate identity, profile, security, and consent sections
Live CFP status with a primary applicant action
Role-aware mobile navigation with current-page and expanded states
Grouped speaker fields, compact staff filters, and contained table scrolling

verification.authLayouts: 55 final synthetic render checks across 11 page states. No page overflow, wrapped controls, missing images, or undersized checked controls.
verification.cfpLayouts: 85 render checks across 17 states. No page overflow, missing images, undersized checked controls, or multiline control labels.
verification.reviewerLayouts: Real browser proof captured reviewer and admin workspaces at 390 and 1440 pixels.
verification.interactions: Exercised auth validation, password visibility, shared profile persistence, consent denial and approval, mobile navigation, CFP profile and settings persistence, draft saving, every submission step, and the receipt.
verification.authAcceptance: 31 passed, 0 failed. Includes registration, verification, recovery, reset, consent, SSO, session isolation, and persistence.
verification.cfpAcceptance: 22 browser checks passed. Includes reviewer scoring, assignments, role enforcement, stale writes, bulk decisions, and provider outage behavior.
verification.build: Auth build and typecheck passed. CFP build, server bundle syntax check, and typecheck passed.
verification.contrast: Sampled rendered auth text pairs ranged from 5.83:1 to 14.62:1. Sampled CFP text pairs ranged from 7.19:1 to 16.84:1.
verification.homepage: Homepage source files match the pre-edit archive. The reduced-motion before/after screenshots have zero differing pixels.
verification.detector: One detector pass per app. Only warnings for the required Space Grotesk font.
verification.finishReview: Separate read-only auth and CFP reviewers returned ship with no material fixes.

gateScope: Locked-system redesign, not a universal gate or accessibility certification. Existing palette, component conventions, and pinned fonts remain. Reviewers used the available reviewer role. Documentation stayed in the main session. No production changes or deployment.

brief: Simplify signed-in Q&A, account/achievements, admin, reviewer/CFP and check-in interfaces without changing the design system
gateScope: In-place usability cleanup. Existing system, shared public chrome, and catalog/export/rotation gates excluded by explicit user scope; no universal 58/58 claim.
